Do not replace either round GRILLE cooling core with the new GLAZED rotunda: keep both original cores, center planted atrium with copper solar cap, left rooftop conservatory and twin blue barrel roofs. Subject: community supermarket, T21_L2500. Exact visible state: stepped metropolitan shopping rotunda.

Progression: Preserve the T01 family DNA and the previously accepted tier. Integrate previous functional capacity compactly upward and rearward, inside the reserved parcel. Current cumulative architectural milestones: repaired retail hall with one gold gear plaque; second broad entrance wing; add a continuous attached side shopping arcade with three thick rounded arches beyond the entrance hood; rear supply wing; add a tall broad central clerestory-vault hall above the existing retail center; second broad retail hall; large rounded entrance hood; continuous solar-roofed hall roof; rounded enamel cold-supply core; broad additional retail-range wing; large rear goods buffer; complete second retail storey; broad supported customer gallery; second tall supply core; large enclosed collection wing; third compact retail storey; vertical planted supply atrium; second coupled upper market wing; thick green-glass rooftop market; large copper-framed solar roof; stepped metropolitan shopping rotunda. No separate freestanding buildings: all wings and modules are structurally attached.
Scale: maximum reserved parcel 22m local X by 18m local Z, maximum family height 25m. This reserved envelope is NOT a visible base. See asset_spec.de.md for this tier's approximate occupied dimensions; render the whole current object, not an empty full-size plot.
Front and camera: local +Y up, front facing +Z, front stays on the lower-left visible face of the image, local +X side on lower-right. Camera at local (+X,+Y,+Z), about 35 degrees elevated, near orthographic 3/4 front view. Never mirror. Ground-center pivot intent; future growth is upward and toward local -Z. The entry and delivery zones stay on +Z.
Materials: warm plaster, sage enamel, matte concrete, mustard gold; epoch treatment: cream plaster, copper, sage enamel, monumental but rounded modular forms. Broad hand-painted color areas and large restrained wear patches. Rounded/beveled silhouettes, thick reconstructable parts, modular retro technology, one or at most two eventual material slots. Green glass must be thick and legible. At most one dominant botanical or grinder motif.
Reference input roles: Image 1 Reclaimed Green Haven gives warm rebuilt shapes and readability; image 2 Herbal Atom Age gives rounded enamel machines and copper/brass; image 3 Burning Hills Afterglow gives hopeful worldbuilding only, NOT its dusk lighting, environment or people. Additional inputs, when present: the family's accepted T01 geometry anchor, then its immediately preceding accepted tier. Preserve their family identity, front and proportions while making the specified large upgrade visible. For T00 use only the intact T01 as extra geometry reference. For T01 or T_FIXED only the three style inputs are supplied.
Composition: exactly one single complete freestanding asset, centered and grounded; square 1024x1024 or larger, generous 10 percent clear margin all around. Plain solid very light warm-gray/off-white background. Neutral even studio light; one soft contact shadow only. All geometry entirely visible.
Technical intent: stylized game-ready smart-topology, clean edges, minimal geometry; no floating parts. Attached architectural planting is allowed; no loose props. A park may contain its intrinsic bounded planted parcel, never a surrounding scenic diorama.
Exclude: people, characters, vehicles, conveyor belts, surrounding scene, landscape, city, unrelated buildings, loose props, diorama ground, text, readable signs, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI, weapons, gore, smoking, smoke, particles, thin antennae, tangled cables, clipped or cropped geometry, baked dramatic shadows, glows, fog or dusk color casts.
